summary: Mapping sites list a Great Hill Lookout Tower, placed in Middlebury by two sources; no source found gives its build date, use or current condition.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts lists a Great Hill entry in Middlebury, New Haven County
evidence.quote: GREAT HILL MIDDLEBURY New Haven County

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap name tag: Great Hill Lookout Tower
TopoZone names the structure Great Hill Lookout Tower in New Haven County
evidence.quote: Great Hill Lookout Tower Topo Map CT, New Haven County (Woodbury Area)

evidence.supports: TopoZone places the tower on its Woodbury map
OpenStreetMap tags the structure as an observation tower
ExpertGPS files the Great Hill Lookout Tower under Middlebury
evidence.quote: Middlebury, CT Towers Great Hill Lookout Tower

sources.title: Great Hill Lookout Tower Topo Map CT, New Haven County (Woodbury Area)

notes_for_editor: No source found gives a build date, builder, use or condition. Town: Middlebury (Forest Lookouts, ExpertGPS) against TopoZone's Woodbury map name; TopoZone's Oxford entry is also filed under a map name rather than its town, so Woodbury may be a map sheet and not a town. Do not confuse this with the Great Hill Fire Tower in Hemenway State Forest, Tamworth, New Hampshire, which search results surfaced. The firetower.org Connecticut register lists eight sites, none of them this one. Elevation differs slightly: 291 m (OpenStreetMap) against 295 m (TopoZone).
